changes_made.explanation: Added missing output types (NLI labels and textual continuations) that are also generated and evaluated in the paper. Maintained 'Other:Natural Language Inference' since NLI is not strictly NLG but is part of the evaluation framework.

Removed 'T/F Acc.' and 'KL Rank. Acc.' as they are not automatic metrics for evaluating generated text outputs. EDIT-F1 is the only true automatic metric used to evaluate the generated disambiguations (paraphrases). T/F Acc. measures model judgment accuracy, and KL Rank. Acc. measures continuation modeling, not output quality.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant criteria into two main evaluation criteria: plausibility of interpretation and correct NLI label selection. Kept the guideline descriptions that accurately summarize the human evaluation process.

overall_notes: The paper primarily evaluates language models' ability to handle ambiguity through generation tasks (paraphrase generation for disambiguation) and NLI tasks. Only one automatic metric (EDIT-F1) is used for generated text evaluation, with comprehensive human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed refinement in distinguishing what constitutes automatic metrics versus other experimental measurements.
